changelog: **Pairing DM and dormant check-ins in chat (#1946):** a new pair's two sides each get one Slack/Teams card in their own language (`introducePairInChat()` from `announceNewRelation()`): the mentee with Book a session, the mentor with the mentee's top three skills. The pairing mail's opt-out applies. The "still interested?" check-in goes as a chat card INSTEAD of the mail for a linked mentee, from the same claimed `dormantNudgeCount` nudge, falling back to the mail when the card cannot be posted. Mail + chat together stay at two per person (`e2e/chat-dormant-cap.spec.ts`). No stage moves, the single writer of `dormantSince` is unchanged, and there is no schema change.

en: New pairs get a short introduction in Slack or Microsoft Teams — the mentee can book a first session right from it.
tr: Yeni eşleşen çiftler Slack veya Microsoft Teams'te kısa bir tanışma mesajı alıyor; mentee ilk görüşmesini doğrudan oradan ayarlayabiliyor.
de: Neue Paare erhalten in Slack oder Microsoft Teams eine kurze Vorstellung – der Mentee kann direkt dort einen ersten Termin buchen.
